title: Analyse cleanup + Monday-brief repair
summary: Analyse is now focused on the report itself: Creator DNA moved out of Analyse, the giant roadmap is collapsed into one cycling progress bar with folded activity, Strip source labels are isolated from Creator DNA, Summary/Takeaways/Re-hooks/Payoffs/Most Replayed are rebuilt around source evidence, Packaging gets an explicit vault receipt, Channel Context stops presenting unknown zeroes, Make It Yours contains context-specific directions and blueprints, Vault Entry is hidden, and Export produces clean full-analysis Markdown for Claude or any other AI.
discord_changes: ANALYSE CLEANUP: Creator DNA moved out of Analyse; giant research roadmap replaced by one compact cycling progress bar and folded Activity.
MONDAY BRIEF REPAIR: Summary, Key Takeaways, Re-hooks, Payoffs and Most Replayed now use source-backed receipts instead of generic filler or broken empty states.

CREATOR OUTPUT: Packaging is explicitly vaulted, Make It Yours contains context-specific directions + beat sheets + thumbnail blueprints, Vault Entry is hidden, and Export is clean Markdown for Claude/AI handoff.
changes: Moved Creator DNA out of the Analyse view into the Vault area so the source report is not cluttered by persistent creator settings.

Collapsed the large research-agent/17-section roadmap into a single sticky progress card that cycles through the current analysis section; detailed Activity remains available in a closed disclosure panel.

Stopped Creator DNA niche/subniche from being used as source-video taxonomy. Strip now derives source topic labels from the video's own title/transcript and replaces unresolved zero metrics with unknown markers.

Rebuilt Summary around five useful answers: what the video is, how it is built, how it is doing, what appears to matter, and what is worth taking. Removed the generic 'video develops the promise...' filler.

Rebuilt Key Takeaways so the section cannot silently print 'no strong deterministic takeaways' when transcript evidence exists; it now selects source-backed lessons across the runtime with timestamp + quote receipts.
Rebuilt Re-hooks around attention-reset candidates, exact timestamps, source lines, why each reset matters, and median spacing.
Rebuilt Payoffs around the first payoff, payoff rate, title-promise term coverage, and chronological proof/demonstration receipts.
Rebuilt Most Replayed to use real heatmap peaks when available; when YouTube withholds the curve it explicitly shows transcript-only hypotheses labelled as hypotheses.
Reformatted the Things to Steal area into two readable columns: transferable mechanics and do-not-copy constraints.

Expanded the real visual pass to show public storyboard samples directly in Analyse and use the optional on-device vision model for composition / consecutive-frame change classification when supported.

Kept audio evidence honest: WPM, attributed tracks and caption-coded sound/music cues are shown when available; waveform-level claims are withheld unless accessible audio + local audio intelligence exist.
Added a Packaging Vault Receipt that preserves title architecture, title terms, hook/title overlap, exact thumbnail source and packaging tags for later Pattern Mine work.
Hardened Channel Context against fake zero values and keeps enriched public subscriber facts separate from unresolved values.

Separated transferable mechanics from Make It Yours. Make It Yours now uses Creator DNA to generate distinct video directions with title variants, exact hook direction, beat sheet, thumbnail composition, steal/do-not-copy rules and post-publish measurement.
Hid the raw Vault Entry section from Analyse while preserving the underlying vault record.
Replaced Export with a clean full-analysis Markdown handoff that can be copied or downloaded for Claude, ChatGPT or another AI, plus print/save-PDF.
Added a v0.37.1 production regression test covering the requested UX and report changes.
known_limitations: YouTube does not expose a reliable Most Replayed curve for every video. When unavailable, YTIntel shows clearly labelled transcript hypotheses rather than fabricating peaks.

Public storyboard sprites are sampled seek-bar evidence rather than every encoded frame. Automatic composition/cut/zoom interpretation is strongest when the optional on-device vision model is available.

True waveform-level music/SFX/silence classification still requires an accessible audio stream plus supported local audio intelligence. Caption-coded cues and attributed tracks remain the zero-credit fallback.
Source niche/subniche inference is deterministic topic extraction, not a universal taxonomy classifier; it is intentionally kept separate from Creator DNA.
Channel-level medians and outlier context depend on the public channel surfaces returned on that run. Unknown values are shown as unknown rather than zero.
why_it_matters: The Analyse page should behave like a premium research deliverable, not an engineering dashboard. This release removes the visible plumbing, restores the Monday brief's core evidence sections, and ends with a creator-specific blueprint plus a portable report that can continue inside another AI.
